title: Spectral p quantity
statement: For $p\in\mathbb{R}$ and $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, define the spectral $p$ quantity as $\left(\sum_{\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n}|\widehat f(\gamma)|^p\right)^{1/p}$, where $\widehat f(\gamma)$ denotes the vector Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\gamma$.
